agentBatches.summary: Read repo examples, created dedicated worktree/branch, established official trail overview, section order, official distances/times/difficulty from Borås Stad, Naturkartan GPX availability for all 10 stages, OSM relation inventory, key caveats and initial geometry metrics.

Six parallel research/report agents completed for section 1 Hindås station to Hestrafors IF. Main thread synthesized official sources, GPX/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field reports and rules/safety into the section research JSON.

laneStatuses.summary: Confirmed official label Sjuhäradsleden etapp 2, Borås distance/time/difficulty 10 km/2.5 hours/Medel, Hestrafors IF in Brandshed start with parking/information at clubhouse, and Bollebygd/Västsverige description of mixed gravel road/path/forest road, hilly terrain and quiet forest lakes. Found official Abborrsjön/Slätthult rest area mention with grill, trash bin and shelter under restoration. Preserved contradictions: Naturkartan 9.3 km vs Borås 10 km, IK Omega vs Olsfors label, separate Start etapp 3 coordinate, and GPX start south of Hestrafors IF clubhouse/access coordinate.

Found sparse but useful recent AllTrails evidence for section 2: 2025-11-16 slippery boardwalks/spångar without chicken wire, 2025-09-06 bugs/overgrowth and no bathrooms, conflicting 2025-05-25 bathroom availability, and winter poor-condition note from 2025-01-02. Older Utsidan/E1 evidence identifies Abborrsjön shelter use/history; Trailforks near Olsfors/Hultafors gives endpoint-area wetness/mud clues. No current formal closure/reroute found.

Audited Naturkartan GPX/API and OSM relation 5604822. Naturkartan GPX has 342 points, one segment, computed 9.304 km, max gap 285.3 m, no >500 m gaps, and direction Hestrafors/Brandshed to IK Omega. OSM relation is connected and matches GPX within about 20 m, but stored east-to-west; reverse OSM if used. GPX start is about 392 m south of Borås Hestrafors IF clubhouse/access coordinate; GPX end matches IK Omega and Etapp 3 GPX start within 7 m. Treat Start etapp 3 coordinate as access/map-label caveat, not section boundary.

Confirmed active Naturkartan/Västkuststiftelsen trail-wide QA warning; no section-2-specific closure/reroute or protected-area intersection found. SÄRF is current fire-ban authority and status must be refreshed at import time. Found Abborrsjön/Slätthult shelter currentness conflict: Bollebygd still says under restoration, while Västkuststiftelsen 2024 report and Vindskyddskartan March 2025 note suggest a new shelter. No official potable water found; treat Aborrsjön water as untreated/unknown if mentioned.

Modeled route endpoints separately from access clusters. Start route endpoint's closest stop is Holmens bro about 1.83 km away on Västtrafik line 122/preordered traffic; Hestrafors IF clubhouse cluster is about 392 m north of route start and has parking/information. End route endpoint/IK Omega has Olsfors and Bråtes bro stops about 0.98 km straight-line away on Västtrafik line 402. Omegastugan/Start etapp 3 access cluster is about 1.1 km south of GPX end and about 179-200 m from Bråtes bro; keep it as access metadata, not route boundary.

Found strong facility candidates at Rastplats Slätthult/Abborrsjön: shelter 57.7081968,12.6209842; toilet 57.7079620,12.6216014; waste basket 57.7081797,12.6210861; firepit/grill 57.7081802,12.6210283. Recommended importing these with shelter currentness caveat and no potable-water claim. Hestrafors IF/Bollevi, IK Omega/Omegastugan, Bråtes bro/Olsfors are access metadata. Hulta GK, Stockasjön/Gesebol and Vannasjön/Vanna kvarn are off-route/pending/suppressed for section 2.

agentBatches.summary: Six parallel research/report agents completed for section 2 Hestrafors IF to IK Omega. Main thread synthesized official sources, GPX/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field reports and rules/safety into the section research JSON.

laneStatuses.summary: Coordinator baseline pass checked Borås/Bollebygd section-3 text and PDFs, Naturkartan GPX and Västtrafik/OSM stop sanity data. Official baseline: IK Omega to SOK-stugan, 10 km, 2.5 hours, 83 m height difference, Medel, 30% asphalt/gravel road and 70% tractor road/path. Naturkartan GPX has 307 points, one segment, computed 10.312 km, start 57.6988914,12.6936707, end 57.732252,12.79876, max gap 296.1 m, no >500 m gaps. Early facility clue: Hultafors Vindskydd/Stora utsikten cluster near 57.7010,12.7568 has shelter/fireplace/toilet/waste evidence and sits directly on/near route around km 4.37. End transit appears weak from SOK-stugan, with Sandared-area stops about 2.4-2.5 km straight-line from the route endpoint.

Found recent AllTrails activity on 2026-04-14 and 2026-04-12 without text notes, 2025-09-07 report of nice sections/shelter with toilet but too much gravel/asphalt and insects, 2025-08-23 report of great conditions/views, bathrooms, dog-friendly and easy parking, plus 2024-10-05 muddy conditions. Trailforks/Fjällaberg and Olsfors-Hultafors segments add wet/mud clues; older Hjälmrydshästar reverse walk confirms place sequence Mölnebäcken, Mölnesjö, Håmosse, Viaredssjön, Fjälla. No current formal closure/reroute found.

Audited Naturkartan GPX/API and OSM relation 4176438. Naturkartan GPX has 307 points, one segment, computed 10.312 km, max gap 296.1 m, no >500 m gaps, start matches IK Omega and section 2 end within about 7 m, and end joins section 4 GPX start within 2.1 m. Borås SOK-stugan coordinate is about 191 m west of the Naturkartan GPX end. OSM is useful but has reverse/awkward member order, one real 51.5 m continuity gap, and ends nearer the SOK-stugan clubhouse coordinate than Naturkartan.

Found no section-3-specific closure/reroute or formal protected-area intersection. Naturkartan/STF trail-wide QA/reroute warnings conflict with Västsverige's claim that stages 3-7 are quality-assured. Stage PDF identifies Håmossen as class I nature value and Mölnebäcken as class II nature value, which are sensitivity notes rather than formal reserve rules. SÄRF fire status must be dynamic; stage PDF and Borås identify fireplace/grill facilities but they are conditional on current fire status. No official potable water found.

Modeled IK Omega route start separately from lower Omegastugan/Olsfors access cluster about 1.14 km south. Closest start stops are Olsfors and Bråtes bro, each about 0.99 km straight-line from the route start on Västtrafik line 402; Bråtes bro is best for Omegastugan access. End route/SOK-stugan closest current stop is Skogshill övre about 1.68 km straight-line on Västtrafik line 151; Sandared station is a secondary stronger hub about 2.55 km away. Older/local pages mention Sandevi, but current Västtrafik/GTFS did not support that stop name.

Confirmed official labels Sjuhäradsleden etapp 3 / IK Omega - SOK-stugan, 10 km, 2.5 hours, Medel/Blå-medel, 83 m height difference, 30% asphalt/gravel and 70% tractor road/path. Section starts in Bollebygd and enters Borås; Borås says this is the first stage through Borås. Official sources identify Hultafors/Stora utsikten shelter with fireplace, compost toilet and waste bin, Håmossen class I nature value, Butorpet/Anneberg/Mölnedal croft remains, Mölnesjö/Mölnebäcken class II nature value, and SOK-stugan/Nordtorp information/grill context. Preserved Naturkartan/STF warning versus Västsverige stage 3-7 quality-assured contradiction.

Found strong Hultafors Vindskydd/Stora utsikten/Viaredssjön cluster around 57.70095,12.75675 with shelter, rest area, viewpoint, fireplace, toilet and waste; OSM/Vindskyddskartan indicate both new and old shelter caveat and water of unknown quality only. Confirmed IK Omega as route-start access only; Omegastugan/Olsfors as off-route access cluster; SOK-stugan/Nordtorp as endpoint access with parking, information and public grill but clubhouse toilets/showers/sauna pending; Håmossen, croft remains and Mölnesjön/Mölnebäcken as POI/context only; Sandared/Hultafors/Rydets access/service/swim items mostly off-route metadata or suppression.

agentBatches.summary: Six parallel research/report agents completed for section 3 IK Omega to SOK-stugan. Main thread synthesized official sources, Naturkartan/OSM geometry, Hultafors/SOK-stugan facilities, commute/access, field reports, rules/safety and currentness into the section research JSON.

laneStatuses.summary: Confirmed official label SOK-stugan - Rya åsar, 13 km, 3.5 hours, Svår/Röd-krävande, 110 m height difference, 35% asphalt/gravel and 65% tractor road/path. Found official Källeberg, Kvarnbäcken, Ramshulan and Rya åsar reserve context plus Borås and Länsstyrelsen reserve sources.

Audited Naturkartan GPX/API and OSM relation 4176439. Naturkartan GPX has 417 points, computed 12.977 km, no >500 m gaps and clean joins to stages 3 and 5. OSM is continuous but stored reverse and uses Borås/OSM access endpoints about 186-200 m from Naturkartan continuity endpoints.

Found Källeberg rest hut/fireplace, Kvarnbäcken historic POI, Hestrastugan grill, Rya åsar Fjällsjön shelter, Högplatån/Björbobacken picnic/fireplace cluster, Ramshulan toilet/picnic/water-pending, and Rya åsar main entrance toilet/info/waste/parking. Flagged SOK utilities and Ramshulan drinking water as pending.

Modeled Naturkartan route endpoints separately from SOK-stugan/Nordtorp and Rya åsar/Björbobacken access clusters. Identified Skogshill övre and Sandared station for the start, and Ekerydavägen, Björbostugan and Ryda for the Rya åsar end, with Västtrafik line 151 and 19 context.

Found recent AllTrails/Naturkartan evidence for good boardwalks, well-maintained trail, very good conditions, easy parking and good signage in 2025. Older sources add hilly/scenic, Källeberg shelter and Rya åsar context. No current closure/reroute found.

Confirmed Rya åsar reserve rules for the final segment, including no tenting/caravan setup, fires only at designated places, no motor vehicles and vegetation/geology protections. Found no section-specific closure; preserved Naturkartan/STF QA warning versus Västsverige quality-assured contradiction.
